01 — About

WHO I AM

I'm a Game Developer based in Lahore, Pakistan with 4+ years shipping games and interactive systems across Unreal Engine 5, Unity, and full-stack multiplayer pipelines.

Currently an Unreal Developer at Narsun Studios building C++-based PCG systems, multiplayer FPS games, procedural environments, and interactive VR safety experiences in UE 5.5. I'm equally comfortable writing Server RPCs in C++, designing custom PCG graph nodes, building branching VR narratives, or crafting pixel-perfect UMG interfaces.

I've also architected cross-engine systems connecting Unreal + Unity + Node.js over real-time sockets, and have delivered projects for international clients on Upwork for 4+ years.

BE Computer Science — University of Central Punjab (2019–2023).
